body:
I'm not opposed to this change, but this means that your links generate different URLs depending on whether or not stuff has loaded, which I think is a bit surprising.

Can you expand a bit about why this functionality would be preferred?

My main reason for wanting this is if you are shared a URL, e.g.

`http://myapp.com/meetings`, the router picks up `useAsDefault`, and changes the URL to `http://myapp.com/meetings/coverage`. However, if you click on a link within the application this doesn't happen.
Looks like this only happens for links triggering changes outside of Angular, like `<a href="#/meetings">` and not using the RouterLink directive.

issue.title: fix(router): set correct redirect/default URL from hashchange

issue.body:

Tracks internal bug b/26013076

Closes #5590
